Risk Statement: Unauthorized access or excessive privileges expose customer data
Treatment / Planned Controls: Implement least privilege; quarterly access review; MFA; privileged activity logging

Risk Statement: API abuse or exploitable authorization flaw enables unauthorized data access
Treatment / Planned Controls: API authorization testing; WAF/rate limiting; secure SDLC testing; logging

Risk Statement: Compromised privileged account could alter infrastructure or access sensitive data
Treatment / Planned Controls: Phishing-resistant MFA; PAM/JIT access; access recertification; alerting

Risk Statement: Ransomware or accidental deletion compromises recoverability
Treatment / Planned Controls: Immutable backups; separate credentials; restore tests; backup monitoring

Information / Value: Application source code and deployment credentials
Risk Statement: Compromised pipeline introduces malicious code into production
Treatment / Planned Controls: Branch protection; signed commits/artifacts; secret scanning; restricted runners; separation of duties

Risk Statement: Malware or lost device leads to credential theft or data exposure
Treatment / Planned Controls: EDR; full-disk encryption; MDM; screen lock; remote wipe; security awareness

Risk Statement: Vendor breach or service failure affects confidentiality or availability
Treatment / Planned Controls: Vendor due diligence; security clauses; annual reassessment; dependency inventory; exit plans

Risk Statement: Insufficient logging or tampering reduces incident detection and audit evidence quality
Treatment / Planned Controls: Centralized logging; restricted access; retention standard; alert coverage review; time synchronization

Information / Value: Human access to systems and data
Risk Statement: Successful phishing or social engineering results in credential compromise
Treatment / Planned Controls: Quarterly training; phishing simulations; targeted training for privileged users

Risk Statement: Delayed or unclear response increases impact of a security event
Treatment / Planned Controls: Severity matrix; playbooks; contact tree; tabletop exercise; lessons learned

Risk Statement: Cloud outage or capacity issue causes prolonged customer disruption
Treatment / Planned Controls: Availability monitoring; capacity thresholds; redundancy; tested recovery procedures

Risk Statement: Data retained longer than necessary increases breach impact and compliance exposure
Treatment / Planned Controls: Retention schedule; automated deletion; backup lifecycle controls; quarterly validation
